page.text:
That constraint is also defined in a `Requires:` section because that
allows the Mathlingua type checker to understand how a statement like `x
"in" X` should be treated if `X \subset Y`.

For example, with this, if one writes `X \:subset:/ \reals` and `\reals`
is defined such that `x "in" \reals` means `x is \real`, then if one
writes `x "in" X` the checker would know that means `x "in" \reals`
which means `x is \real`. This is needed because the details in the
satisfies section is opaque to the checker.
